# Book of Truth — Sourcing & References

**Scope gate.** This instruction is relevant only when a request concerns _The Book of Truth_ (Maria Divine Mercy) corpus. It auto-attaches to the four folders above, so if a file there does not mention the corpus, ignore this file.

## Always point to the resources page

- **Always** mention [book-of-truth/resources.md](../../book-of-truth/resources.md) whenever the corpus is discussed — in chat answers, and when a document in [book-of-truth/](../../book-of-truth/), [eschatology/](../../eschatology/), [miracles/](../../miracles/), or [liturgy/](../../liturgy/) is created or revised.
- That page is the repository's hub for **where the corpus's primary text circulates** — compiled PDFs, read-online archives, the published five-volume set, audio, and citation notes.
- Link it; do not restate it. Follow the **Link, don't embed** principle: never copy its URL tables or source lists into other documents.
- From inside `book-of-truth/`, use the relative link `[resources.md](resources.md)`; from elsewhere, use `[book-of-truth/resources.md](book-of-truth/resources.md)`.

## Never mistake a source for approval

- The resources page is a **pointer list, not an endorsement**. The corpus's unapproved status is established in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and in the book-of-truth pages themselves; this file does not duplicate that framing, and you need not restate it each time.
- Never present a mirror, PDF compilation, or retail listing as a Church source or as approval. Free mirrors are promoter-run or unauthorised third-party uploads.

## Cite the edition, and separate claim from doctrine

- Cite the **specific edition and source** — e.g. "Mary Refuge of Souls PDF, 4 March 2015 edition" — because ordering, numbering, and page counts differ between the free PDFs, the online archive, and the printed volumes (see the page's citation notes).
- Keep the three registers distinct: **quoted corpus text** (as its promoters publish it), **Catholic doctrine** (cited to the CCC, CIC, councils, or papal documents), and **your own analysis**. Never let a corpus assertion stand as Church teaching.
- Never date-set or present a corpus prediction as fulfilled fact; speak of it as a claim.

## Keep the source list current

- Add new primary-text sources, or mark dead/rotated links, in [book-of-truth/resources.md](../../book-of-truth/resources.md) rather than scattering links across other pages, and note the date on which the links were checked.
- Treat link rot as expected: prefer the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine when a mirror is dead, and record that substitution in the resources page.
